description.value: In areas of bright light, holy elementals are invisible. As with greater invisibility, they may attack and still remain invisible. In shadowy illumination, a holy elemental loses this invisibility, though like all creatures in shadows, they have concealment unless the viewer has darkvision.

1/day, a holy elemental can use dimension door, transporting only itself and up to 50 pounds of material. The start and end points of the teleport must be in areas of bright light; if the destination lacks sufficient light, the teleport fails but does not expend the ability for the day.

effect: Self and up to 50 lb.; both endpoints must be brightly lit. Refund the use if the destination is too dim.

description.value: When a holy elemental deals holy damage to a creature, that creature must succeed on a Fortitude save or be dazzled for 1 round. The save DC is listed in the elemental's stat block and is Constitution-based.

effect: When a holy elemental deals holy damage to a creature, that creature must succeed on a Fortitude save or be dazzled for 1 round. The save DC is listed in the elemental's stat block and is Constitution-based.
Whenever the elemental deals light damage, resolve this save once.

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds, a holy elemental can shoot out a bolt of light towards a single target within 30 feet. The holy elemental must make a ranged touch attack (+7), if it hits, the attack deals 1d6+5 points of holy damage. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 17).
